name: EKI Energy Services Limited
about: EKI Energy Services Limited, together with its subsdiaries, engages in the provision of carbon credit offsetting and carbon advisory services, and implementation and development of carbon credit eligible projects in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Trading & Other Business, and Generation. The company offers sustainability and net zero services, such as AA1000 AS assurance providers by accountability, climate change, sustainability and ESG, sustainable supply chain, green certification and resource efficiency services; and community based projects, nature-based solutions, and ESCO energy efficiency projects. It also provides carbon avoidance and removal, extended producer responsibility (EPR), EPR credits, plastic credits, and green power/renewable energy attribute certificates projects; and offset portfolio management services, including operationalization of article 6 of paris agreement, carbon budgets and stock-take, and internationally transferred mitigation outcomes; and carbon offset, renewable energy attribute certificates, extended producer responsibilities, and plastic credits projects. In addition, the company offers comprehensive sustainability and ESG advisory services, such as greenhouse gas accounting, environmental, social and governance (ESG) strategy and reporting, carbon and climate risk management, life cycle assessment, biodiversity, regulatory compliance, and green building and product certification consulting; and net zero and decarbonisation roadmap development, science-based targets initiative target setting and support, reporting, carbon border adjustment mechanism advisory, business responsibility and sustainability report preparation, EcoVadis performance support, environmental product declarations, water footprint studies, green building certification consulting, and customized ESG capacity building and training programmes. EKI Energy Services Limited was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Indore, India.
